products.title: Anxiety Fidget Ring
products.body_html:
Spinning a ring dedicated to anxiety is a way of bringing yourself into the present and acknowledging that you have anxiety, which can actually be calming in its own way. Wear this ring alone, or pair it with our Breathe Spinner Necklace as the two products go hand in hand.

This ring was created to help cope with nervous or stressful moments. Our team couldn't be happier this ring was released as many of them struggle with anxiety on the daily.

PLEASE NOTE THAT WE RECOMMEND SIZING UP DUE TO THE BEADS ON THE RING
